description: This file defines the Git::IndexInfo package, providing methods to create, update, and remove entries in a Git index, handling low-level interactions with the Git index data, including communication with external processes via pipes.

classes.name: Git::IndexInfo
classes.description: A class that manages interactions with the Git index, allowing modifications such as adding, removing, and updating index entries, interfacing with Git through command pipes.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new IndexInfo object, setting up communication pipes with the Git process and configuring the hash algorithm.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the index for a specified path by writing to the associated pipe.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or adds an entry to the index with specified mode, hash, and path, by writing formatted data to the pipe.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that closes the communication pipe with the Git process.
